PC: Institute interventions in the acutely hypoxic patient including: o Application of supplemental oxygen o Mask ventilation o Intubation (understand the necessity and the basic steps) o Mechanical ventilation
MK: State basic ventilator settings (minute ventilation $\mathbf { \Psi } = \mathsf { V } _ { \intercal } \times \mathsf { R R } )$ ).
ICS: Students are reminded always to talk to the patient in a reassuring manner even if uncertain whether the patient is aware of what is going on.
